capabilities.title: Open human-like agent persona: persistent character, tone, and behavioral profile
capabilities.sourceEvidence: OpenHuman: framework for building AI agents with stable, human-like personas
capabilities.reason: Nexus agents use system prompts for persona but do not have a structured persistent persona profile object.

capabilities.title: Configurable personality traits: curiosity, assertiveness, caution, empathy levels
capabilities.sourceEvidence: OpenHuman personality config: trait sliders that affect agent response style
capabilities.reason: Nexus has no personality trait configuration system for agents.

capabilities.title: Emotional state modeling: agent tracks and expresses simulated emotional state
capabilities.sourceEvidence: OpenHuman emotion module: valence/arousal state that influences tone
capabilities.reason: Nexus is an intelligence dashboard, not a companion app. Emotional state simulation is out of scope and could mislead users about AI nature.

capabilities.title: Long-term relationship memory: remember user preferences and history across many sessions
capabilities.sourceEvidence: OpenHuman long-term memory: user model updated across sessions
capabilities.reason: Nexus memoryPagesStore.ts has session memory; a user-preference model that persists across sessions and shapes agent behavior is pending.
